parameters.content:
## Amazon Deals Grid Tracker by Category & Discount

**Actor:** [Amazon Deals Grid Tracker by Category & Discount](https://apify.com/dataspryva/amazon-deals-grid-tracker-by-category-and-discount)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/amazon-deals-grid-tracker-by-category-and-discount.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `marketplace` (string, required)
- `categories` (array)
- `collection` (string)
- `brand` (string)
- `minRating` (integer)
- `priceMin` (integer)
- `priceMax` (integer)
- `discountMin` (integer)
- `discountMax` (integer)
- `primeExclusiveOnly` (boolean)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `maxItems` (integer)

### Output fields
- `asin` (Asin)
- `title` (Title)
- `dealPrice` (Deal Price)
- `savingsPercent` (Savings Percent)
- `averageRating` (Average Rating)
- `dealEndsAt` (Deal Ends At)
- `category` (Category)

description: Amazon deals grid: runs the Amazon Deals Grid Tracker by Category & Discount Apify Actor, returns asin, title, dealPrice, savingsPercent, averageRating and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
